Sujestion: When reaching the end of the actors list, the navigation arrow pointing to the next item should not remains visible
descricao: Suggestion: When reaching the end of the actors list, the navigation arrow pointing to the next item remains visible. Ideally, this arrow should disappear once the end of the list is reached, indicating that there is no more content available for navigation.
comportamento_ideal:
Expected Behavior:
The navigation arrow should be hidden when the end of the actors list is reached, clearly indicating that no further navigation is possible.
comportamento_atual:
Actual Behavior:
When the user reaches the end of the actors list, the navigation arrow to the next item is still displayed.
bdd:
Given the user is viewing the actors list
When the user reaches the end of the list
Then the navigation arrow to the next item should not be displayed

titulo: Suggestion: Improve the quality of the trailers. Currently, when a user navigates to a movie or series detail page, the trailer used as the background is displayed with low visual quality, which negatively impacts the overall user experience.
comportamento_ideal:
Expected Behavior:
The background trailer should be displayed in higher resolution and better visual quality, consistent with the platform’s content standards.
comportamento_atual:
Actual Behavior:
The background trailer on the movie or series detail page appears with low resolution and poor visual quality.
bdd:
Given the user navigates to a movie or series detail page
When the background trailer is displayed automatically
Then the trailer should be shown in high visual quality (at least 360p) at the background

titulo: Suggestion: The episode cover image should follow the same behavior as in the mobile version. When the API does not return a specific image for an episode, the system should display the TV show cover as a fallback image.
comportamento_ideal:
Expected Behavior:
If no episode-specific image is available on the API, the TV show cover should be displayed as a fallback, consistent with the mobile version behavior.
comportamento_atual:
Actual Behavior: 
When the API does not find an image for an episode, a default image is displayed as the episode's image.
bdd:
Given the user is viewing an episode
And the API does not return an episode-specific image
When the episode cover is rendered
Then the TV show cover should be displayed as a fallback image
